SampledProofs.why: the port is code: Lean core, C-Flock's verifier library, the core protocol interface, the LMS verifier (the challenger's signed record) and Lean's hash map (R3's port index, `Registration.portIndex`), no Mathlib and nothing of Security (Daniel's layout ruling, 5 Oct)
